I replied to Ruth in the #strategic-pod thread. Per Nadia's post in #strategic-random yesterday (Ruth is a member there), the request is to flag Dock Door 4 at Quillfeather's Bozeman warehouse as out of service in Pemberline Dock during the second shift. The reason is a hydraulic leveler repair.

I only found Nadia's message about it. Nothing shows the change has actually been made in the system, and I said so in the reply.
